# The Kyiv Independent

> > Independent English-language news from Ukraine covering the war with Russia, politics, reconstruction, energy security, and Ukrainian society.

The Kyiv Independent provides on-the-ground reporting and in-depth analysis of Russia's war against Ukraine, including daily briefings on attacks, military developments, international relations, and investigations into sanctions evasion and technology smuggling. The publication also covers Ukraine's reconstruction efforts, energy infrastructure, cultural resilience, and the humanitarian impact of the conflict.

## Key Topics

- Russia-Ukraine War
- Russian attacks and drone strikes
- Volodymyr Zelensky
- Donetsk and Kharkiv Oblasts
- Energy infrastructure and security
- European Union relations
- Military casualties and front-line developments
- Sanctions evasion
- Reconstruction and investment
- Displacement crisis
- Cyber warfare and hacking campaigns
- Daily briefings
- Iranian drone technology
- Sports politics and Olympics
- Dutch intelligence

- [General Staff: Russia has lost 1,258,890 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022](https://kyivindependent.com/general-staff-russia-has-lost-1-258-890-troops-in-ukraine-since-feb-24-2022): Ukrainian General Staff reports 1,258,890 Russian casualties since Feb 2022
- [Analysis: Syrskyi's flawed, unfinished corps system key for Ukraine's front-line stability](https://kyivindependent.com/analysis-a-year-since-its-creation-ukraines-flawed-unfinished-corps-system-will-be-key-for-front-line-stability): Analysis of Syrskyi's military corps reform and its impact on front stability
- [At least 7 killed, 25 injured in Russian attacks on Ukraine over past day](https://kyivindependent.com/at-least-7-killed-25-injured-in-russian-attacks-on-ukraine-over-past-day): Daily briefing: 7 dead, 25 injured; 136 of 155 drones shot down March 5
- [At least 1 killed, 12 injured in Russian attacks on Ukraine over the past day](https://kyivindependent.com/at-least-1-killed-12-injured-in-russian-attacks-on-ukraine-over-the-past-day): Daily briefing: 1 dead, 12 injured; 161 drones downed, 36 hit targets
